autonomy: --agent danger: no permission prompts; no turn cap (the wall clock is the cap)
notes: Same pin and same reasoning as bench/agent-bench/agents/freecode.json, minus `--max-turns`: an optimisation run is a climb, and jcode's published runs took 30–160 grades. The runner's --timeout is the only cap, and time is recorded rather than judged (jcode bench: 'time is recorded, not capped'). Gates are inherited from the operator's env: FREECODE_AUTO_POKE=1 etc. are passed through and recorded on the trial as harnessFlags, so a run with auto-poke on is labelled as such on the page.
